lines.l: Ow!
A key of a political game
What for there is to be
There is no crisis
There is no glory
Need to move and decide
Where it is to be for forever and all
A peaceful place, a place of fear
Where every day feels like no care
Covered in mud, tired and wet
I didn't really show a sound of fear
Into the grave of your pain
I'm fed
And in this war
Where all hope is dead
No turning back
Sacrifice all
Into the meat
By the pain
Of fire
Another offensive
Another attack
Keep some ground
Before going back
It was pointless as the risk of the war
But our freedom is worth dying for
We may pay for the core of the attack
And I'm there, insisting no turning back
Kill all the kill, there's no other way
I turn into hell, into the grave
Into the meat grinder I am fed
No manless war, we're all always dead
No turning back, sacrifice all
Into the meat grinder I'm fed
Concentrations for when we run
All now to pilot, clinging to my gun
Heat from explosions, village ripped in air
Burning inferno, death is everywhere
Pain in my chest, like hitting a wall
My legs fail, I crumble and fall
Blood everywhere, lying on my back
My vision is fading as red
Turns to flash
Blood and tears
Planned with the rain
A life demarcated end of pain
Another statistic, yet another death
As war rages on, the grinder is fed
Into the meat grinder we are fed
And in this war, where all hope is dead
No turning back
